sources.name: Maurice Franklin
sources.quote: After coming home from the hospital, I had to get my feet back on the ground, and the first thing I did was check my finances. The card statement was the first thing I read and it's been on my mind ever since.

sources.name: Geneva Zhou
sources.quote: My life has changed a lot since welcoming a new child. It's not the big stuff like changing diapers or feedings that's surprising, it's the little moments like watching Rosa press her nose against the crib bars gently, like she's afraid of something. The house feels quieter at night now, like the whole city could be gone and I wouldn't notice.

sources.name: Maren Johns
sources.quote: I've been getting used to not having patients to see. It's been a bit of an adjustment. I did help paint over some graffiti on the recreation center wall with some neighbors recently.

sources.name: Antoine Vermeer
sources.quote: To be honest, I'm still figuring out my plans after retiring as Senior Pastor. It's been a big change for me, not having the responsibilities of the church to attend to every day. I'm enjoying the quiet, but I'm not sure what I'm going to do with all my time yet. I've got some ideas floating around, but nothing concrete.

approvedQuotes.text: After coming home from the hospital, I had to get my feet back on the ground, and the first thing I did was check my finances. The card statement was the first thing I read and it's been on my mind ever since.

My life has changed a lot since welcoming a new child. It's not the big stuff like changing diapers or feedings that's surprising, it's the little moments like watching Rosa press her nose against the crib bars gently, like she's afraid of something. The house feels quieter at night now, like the whole city could be gone and I wouldn't notice.
I've been getting used to not having patients to see. It's been a bit of an adjustment. I did help paint over some graffiti on the recreation center wall with some neighbors recently.

To be honest, I'm still figuring out my plans after retiring as Senior Pastor. It's been a big change for me, not having the responsibilities of the church to attend to every day. I'm enjoying the quiet, but I'm not sure what I'm going to do with all my time yet. I've got some ideas floating around, but nothing concrete.
